announcement.title: Chat mode and smoother Agents lists
announcement.description:
Desktop and web now offer Chat alongside Agents and Sessions. Choose a view from the sidebar dropdown; your conversations, drafts, models and existing Sessions controls stay available. The dropdown also fits narrow sidebars and larger zoom levels.

On phones and tablets, the two views are Agents and Chats. Existing Sessions open in the simpler Chats view. Developer and Git controls are hidden on mobile, while saved preferences, conversations, permissions, model choices and desktop features are preserved. Agent status updates now avoid refreshing unrelated rows, and shared status loading avoids duplicate requests.

Known issues remain under investigation: Hermes startup on Intel Macs, protected Claude cleanup and OpenCode startup on Windows, and Antigravity startup on Linux. Windows installers remain unsigned.
